name: 1Password
summary: 1Password Business costs $8.99 per user a month on annual billing and is the lowest 1Password plan with single sign-on. Teams of up to 10 people can start on the Teams Starter Pack, which leaves out single sign-on and automated provisioning.

facts.text: Vault data is encrypted on the device with AES-GCM-256, using keys derived from the account password and a 128-bit Secret Key that 1Password never stores.
1Password lists SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001:2022 among its certifications.
1Password describes itself as HIPAA compliant, and its support site says it is not a Business Associate and does not sign a business associate agreement.
In September 2023, 1Password reported suspicious activity in its Okta instance linked to the Okta support system breach, and said no 1Password user data was accessed.
1Password runs a public bug bounty program on HackerOne.

plans.name: Teams Starter Pack
plans.unit: per pack of up to 10 users
plans.notes: Billed yearly; the plan card shows it as $2.49 per user. Extra seats cost $4.99 each per month, up to 20 users.

hiddenCosts: Single sign-on and automated user provisioning need the Business plan; the Teams Starter Pack does not include them.
Business accounts pay a prorated fee for each guest beyond 20.
Device Trust and SaaS Manager are sold separately at quoted prices.

contract.cancellation: Business fees are non-cancelable and non-refundable except as the agreement states.
contract.dataExport: Desktop apps export to 1PUX or CSV; the CSV covers logins and passwords only.
